jobs.title: Databricks Data Engineer
jobs.description: Join Deloitte's Core AI & Data practice and help organizations modernize data platforms, strengthen enterprise data foundations, and scale analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities. As a Databricks Data Engineer, you will support the design, build, and optimization of cloud-based data engineering solutions that enable large-scale transformation. You will work with business and technology teams to modernize data environments, support analytics and artificial intelligence use cases, and deliver measurable business outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to help clients implement enterprise-scale Databricks solutions that improve platform performance and expand data-driven decision-making. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026. Work you'll do As a Data Engineer II on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and data engineering solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, and Structured Query Language (SQL) Support the modernization of enterprise data platforms by implementing cloud-based ingestion, transformation, and storage patterns Develop and maintain batch and streaming data workflows that support reporting, analytics, and artificial intelligence use cases Apply data architecture, integration, and data modeling practices to improve data quality, scalability, and platform performance Collaborate with client and Deloitte teams to troubleshoot issues, implement enhancements, and support delivery of large-scale data transformation programs A successful candidate would possess these skills: Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to provide clear guidance to others The team Deloitte's Core AI & Data practice helps organizations modernize data platforms, strengthen enterprise data foundations, and scale analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities across the business. The team works with clients to architect, engineer, and deploy cloud-based data solutions that improve decision-making, enable innovation, and support large-scale transformation. Practitioners collaborate across business and technology functions to solve complex challenges in data modernization, governance, platform engineering, and insight delivery. Qualifications Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Mathematics, or Statistics 3+ years of experience in data engineering, extract, transform, load (ETL) development, or data platform engineering 2+ years of experience building data pipelines in Databricks using Apache Spark, Python, and Structured Query Language (SQL) Experience implementing data models, data integration patterns, and cloud-based data processing workflows Experience working with at least one cloud platform: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. Preferred: Experience with Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, and Unity Catalog Experience using Git-based version control and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines Experience supporting batch and streaming data workloads Experience with data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and performance optimization Experience supporting analytics or machine learning data pipelines Experience working in consulting or client service delivery environments The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $86,700 to $170,900. Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join-deloitte-assistance-for-disabled-applic...

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. The opportunity As a Supervising Associate - Data Delivery & Operations, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of enterprise data, analytics and AI solutions. Working alongside talented engineering teams and business stakeholders, you'll design, build and support modern data platforms, advanced analytics capabilities and AI-powered solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role offers a unique opportunity to work hands-on with emerging AI technologies, including the development and deployment of intelligent agents, generative AI solutions and cloud-based platforms. You'll collaborate directly with internal teams and stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions while helping advance our AI and data capabilities. If you're passionate about data engineering, AI innovation and solving complex business challenges, this role provides the opportunity to make a tangible impact while helping lead the evolution of AI agent architecture, automation and enterprise analytics. Your Key Responsibilities Execute and coordinate assigned technical work across the design, development, testing, deployment and production support of enterprise data solutions. Manage defined technical deliverables and workstreams, escalating risks, dependencies and decisions to the Assistant Director when required. Investigate technical and production issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate fixes with development, testing and business teams. Review code, configurations, data models, data pipelines, business logic and technical documentation for completeness, accuracy and adherence to established standards. Translate stakeholder requirements into clear technical tasks, acceptance criteria and delivery plans. Support quality-assurance and user-acceptance testing, including test-case preparation, defect investigation, resolution tracking and validation of completed fixes. Produce and maintain technical specifications, process documentation, operating procedures, support guides and knowledge-transfer materials. Provide day-to-day technical guidance, share leading practices, support less-experienced colleagues and promote consistent development, testing and documentation standards. Support onshore and offshore transitions through structured knowledge transfer, technical and operational handovers, dependency tracking and post-transition stabilization. Coordinate across geographies and time zones to ensure technical issues are assigned, tracked and resolved. Skills And Attributes For Success Strong data-engineering knowledge across data ingestion and integration, transformation and orchestration, data modelling, data quality and reconciliation, testing and validation, monitoring, issue management, deployment and production support. Ability to review technical designs and work products, identify issues and recommend practical improvements. Ability to provide technical guidance while operating effectively as an individual contributor. Collaborative approach, with a willingness to share knowledge, mentor colleagues, resolve issues and provide constructive feedback. Sound judgment in identifying matters that require architectural, strategic or stakeholder decisions and escalating them promptly. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues, risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore teams while maintaining clear ownership, communication and follow-through. To qualify for the role, you must have A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent technology-related discipline, such as Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Applied Mathematics or another quantitative field with a significant computing component. 2-5 years of progressive professional experience in data engineering, data platforms, analytics engineering, business intelligence or related technology-delivery roles. Hands-on experience developing or supporting data and analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric, with experience in at least one of these platforms required. Experience building, maintaining or troubleshooting data pipelines and integrations across multiple systems and data sources. Experience supporting the design, development, testing, deployment and production operation of enterprise data solutions. Experience independently managing defined technical deliverables or workstreams. Experience investigating technical issues, performing root-cause analysis and coordinating fixes. Experience reviewing technical outputs, data pipelines, business logic and supporting documentation. Experience supporting testing activities and maintaining technical and operational documentation. Experience supporting onshore/offshore transitions, knowledge transfer, handovers and stabilization. Ideally, you'll also have Experience with Azure AI Foundry. Experience designing, creating, configuring or supporting AI and data agents using Databricks Genie, Microsoft Fabric Data Agents or comparable agent-based technologies. Experience implementing generative AI, natural-language analytics, conversational data experiences or AI-enabled business insights. Experience with Power BI, semantic models, DAX, Power Query or related Microsoft analytics technologies. Relevant Microsoft Azure, Databricks or Microsoft Fabric certifications. jobs.title: Data Engineer, Video Platform

This role emphasizes building, optimizing, and maintaining robust data processing architectures that support new data and ETL pipelines. Your expertise will ensure that data flows reliably and accurately across various systems, empowering stakeholders with high-quality, actionable insights that impact quality of service, quality of experience and cost optimizations. Responsibilities: - Craft optimal end to end data processing architecture and systems for new data and ETL pipelines. - Design, build, and maintain efficient and reliable data pipelines to move and transform big datadata. - Implement and monitor quality control measures to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency. - Drive internal process improvements and automate manual processes for data quality and SLA management. - Create and maintain technical documentation, such as data dictionaries, data flow diagrams, and system documentation, to ensure efficient and effective data management and analysis. - Work closely with data engineering and various vertical teams within the Video Architecture platform and cross-functional teams within USDS. jobs.title: Data Analyst (Austin)
jobs.description: Who We Are The Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) connects people with careers across the state. We're a Family Friendly Certified Workplace with a great work-life balance, competitive salaries, extensive opportunities for training and professional development, and fantastic benefits. The Information Innovation & Insight division is looking to hire a Data Analyst III position located at 101 E. 15th Street in Austin, TX. TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H-1B, F-1 (OPT/CPT), or H-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. TWC offers flexible schedules and requires work hours that are Monday to Friday between the hours of 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Flex scheduling is available depending on work performance and/or demonstration of need, but the individual should have the ability to be available for most peak business hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM). If a file contains two items (e.g., a cover letter and writing sample), it must be labeled as such. Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered, even if all requested items are included. Who You Are TWC’s Information Innovation & Insight (I/3) Division is seeking a creative, experienced, and motivated Data Analyst III to spearhead critical data projects focused on program integrity and fraud prevention in Unemployment Insurance (UI) and Child Care and Early Learning (CCEL). We are looking for a forward-thinking individual who not only executes tasks but also works proactively to identify efficient methods to uncover anomalies, detect fraudulent patterns, and protect agency resources. The Data Analyst III will learn quickly, value public service, and pursue analytical work to unlock the power of data to improve TWC's services for Texas employers, individuals, families, and communities. The Data Analyst III will work with the Unemployment Insurance, Program Integrity, and Child Care (UIPIC) team, which has eight members. The UI program is designed to help support Texans who lose their jobs through no fault of their own until they can find new employment. The team’s program integrity work is aimed at defending the UI trust fund and Texas childcare system against fraud. Meanwhile, the team helps TWC’s CCEL Division strategically distribute funding and plan subsidized Child Care supports for parents and guardians who are working or looking for work. Members of the UIPIC team operate collaboratively in an environment that encourages cross-training and peer mentorship. They frequently interact with TWC’s Fraud Deterrence and Compliance Monitoring (FDCM) Division on joint initiatives. Staff are mostly self-directed and produce high-quality research and evaluation work to solve system problems and build better fraud detection and fund allocation systems. The Data Analyst III will work under general supervision with moderate latitude for the use of initiative, creativity, innovation, and independent judgment. Candidates must have excellent active listening skills, be able to deliver constructive feedback, and be master communicators who can distill complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences. What You Will Do Perform moderately complex to complex (journey-level) data analysis and data research work. Work involves conducting detailed analysis of, and extensive research on, data; providing results; and monitoring and implementing data quality. As a Data Analyst III in this specialized role, you will perform data analysis work from gathering and managing large datasets to identifying anomalies targeted at fraud detection and risk mitigation. Your work will generate crucial insights into program vulnerabilities, directly inform agency leadership, and support complex investigations involving sensitive law enforcement data. You Will Be Trusted To Develop, implement, and optimize databases, data collection systems, and data analytics techniques; Collaborate closely with internal investigative units and external law enforcement partners to analyze sensitive data, trace fraudulent activities, and support ongoing investigations; Conduct multiple simultaneous tasks and prepare ad hoc analyses and reports on short timeframes; Formulate and deploy methods for mitigating and correcting data entry, integrity, and collection issues to prevent exploitation; Present, interpret, and meaningfully contextualize data for technical and nontechnical audiences; Prepare and present concise, comprehensive technical reports that provide clear, audience-appropriate explanations of investigative findings and risk assessments; Maintain strict compliance with data security protocols and handle confidential law enforcement data with the highest level of integrity and security; Demonstrate proficiency in computer programming and data analytic software use (e.g., SQL, Python, R); Commit to continuous professional development to cultivate technical skills and program knowledge; and Perform other work duties as assigned and required to cultivate the agency’s programs. You Qualify With Two years of full-time experience in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field. Relevant academic credits may be applied toward experience qualifications for this position. You Are a Great Fit With Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field is generally preferred. Knowledge of SQL, Python and/or R. Training and/or experience in applying descriptive and inferential statistical techniques for business and economic decision making, including measures of central tendency/dispersion; probability distributions; sampling distributions; confidence intervals; hypothesis testing; simple linear regression; and correlation analysis. Training and/or experience in additional analytical techniques, such as forecasting; general and generalized linear models; nonparametric statistical hypothesis testing; hierarchical models; and interactive data visualization. Proven ability to manage and manipulate large, complex data sets to provide advanced analysis and actionable insights. A strong drive for continuous learning and a proactive mindset toward improving processes and products. You Gain A Family Friendly Certified Workplace Competitive salary: $5,000 - $6,000/month (Depending on experience) Defined Retirement Benefit Plan Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts Medical Insurance Paid time off, including time for vacation, sick and family care leave Additional benefits for active employees can be found at https://www.ers.texas.gov/Active-Employees/Health-Benefits Duty involves up to 5% travel within the state of Texas. Veterans Use your military skills to qualify for this position or other jobs! Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications, and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser: https://hr.sao.texas.gov/Compensation/MilitaryCrosswalk/MOSC_PlanningResearchandStatistics.pdf How To Apply To be considered, please complete a State of Texas Application for Employment and apply online at www.workintexas.com or on Taleo (Job Search). TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals currently on H-1B, F-1 (OPT/CPT), or H-4 visas. You must be a Texas resident to work for the Texas Workforce Commission or willing to relocate to Texas. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire. A position utilizing this classification will be designated as security sensitive according to the Texas Labor Code, Section 301.042.

jobs.title: Data Engineer Graduate (Data Platform - Global Live) - 2027 Start
jobs.description: Responsibilities About the team: The Data Platform Global Live team is dedicated to empowering the growth of TikTok LIVE business through big data. We support our businesses in achieving their missions by building high quality real-time and offline data warehouses, creating various forms of efficient and data-friendly data assets, and exploring and implementing business oriented data solutions leveraging big data technology and LLM. We provide stable and reliable data capabilities for daily operations, analyses, decision-making of TikTok LIVE features, in addition to robust data support to enhance live performance for streamers. As a data engineer in the Global Live team, you will have the opportunity to build, optimize and grow one of the largest data platforms in the world. You'll have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience on all kinds of systems in the data platform ecosystem and explore applications of latest technologies including LLM for data. Your work will have a direct and huge impact on the company's core products as well as hundreds of millions of users. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early. Responsibilities: Understanding business problems, designing and implementing easy-to-use data solutions for businesses. Collaborating with data engineers to understand the data system and provide a smooth data usage experience for data users, including but not limited to data discovery, data usage guidance, and promotion of the data system. Collaborating with business teams from all over the world to drive user growth and revenue growth. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computing Engineering or a related discipline. Good experience in data solutions, such as data consulting, product development, and data tools creation. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and data metrics. Have an understanding of data warehousing and the construction ideas of the data system. Experience with coding (SQL, Python, etc.) Passionate and self-motivated about using data to drive business decisions. Preferred Qualifications: Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Master's degree in Computer Science, Computing Engineering or a related discipline. Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually) The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $128000 - $316800 annually. jobs.title: Data and Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: About The Role As a Data and Machine Learning Engineer , you will make an impact by designing, building, and optimizing scalable data platforms and machine learning solutions within a Microsoft Azure environment. You will be a valued member of the Data Engineering team and work collaboratively with data scientists, cloud engineers, architects, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and production-ready solutions. In This Role, You Will Design, develop, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT pipelines. Build and optimize Azure-based data platforms using Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Data Lake, and related cloud technologies. Deploy, operationalize, and support machine learning solutions through CI/CD pipelines and MLOps practices. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data and machine learning workloads to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to translate business and technical requirements into production-ready solutions. Work model At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Mason, Ohio. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What You Need To Have To Be Considered Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or Cloud Platform Engineer. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data engineering and analytics services. Proficiency in Python, SQL, and/or Scala. Experience developing, supporting, and optimizing production-grade data pipelines. Hands-on experience with Apache Spark, Databricks, or comparable distributed data processing frameworks. Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and MLOps practices. Ability to independently design, develop, troubleshoot, and deliver technical solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills with experience working across cross-functional teams. These Will Help You Stand Out Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Data Lake. Knowledge of MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Experience with Delta Lake, Parquet, and modern cloud data architectures. Familiarity with infrastructure as code, orchestration frameworks, and cloud monitoring tools. Exposure to enterprise data integrations, including SAP Change Data Capture (CDC). Experience working in Agile development environments. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role. Salary And Other Compensation Applications will be accepted until November 08, 2026 The annual salary for this position is between $ 130,000 - $ 150,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off 401(k) plan and contributions Long-term/Short-term Disability Paid Parental Leave Employee Stock Purchase Plan Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.
